The root `user.message` echo, root `assistant.turn_start`, a failure, or the end or abort of that turn clears that activity; a late abort or idle from an earlier turn does not, and a failure reported for a waiting replacement turn is shown even while late events of the aborted turn are dropped. There is no structured plugin list, so the English message text is shown as is. Progress outside a pending turn, such as preparation started by custom agent selection, is only logged. A failure reported while no turn is waiting, such as after a background policy refresh, is kept and shown when the next message is admitted (its root `user.message` echo), unless that message's own preparation reports a newer failure or a `managed_plugins_complete` info arrives first. After a failure the runtime pauses automatic retries for about an hour or until the managed settings change. The local management bridge `retryManagedPlugins(provider, session, chat)` runs `rpc.plugins.retryManaged()` in that exact live chat right away and returns the per-plugin results; there is no client-level fallback, and the runtime throws when it does not prepare managed plugins for the session. The retry reports progress and failures through the same events, so the rules above apply; a retry in which no plugin failed drops a held failure. In chat, the failure warning ends with a trusted Retry link only when the client has that local bridge (`supportsManagedPluginRetry`); other hosts and clients show the plain warning. The link's command shows notification progress, then a warning that lists each failed plugin as `spec: error`, or information when the plugins are ready or deferred to the next message.
